```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 2. Start building the HTML table manually
cat('<table class="table table-striped table-hover">')
cat('<tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr>')

# 3. Loop through each row and write the HTML directly
for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  # Build the image path
  img_url <- paste0("[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/)", trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i]), "@main/Capture.PNG")
  
  # Build the demo path
  repo_name <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo_name, "/")
  
  # Print the row
  cat('<tr>')
  cat(paste0('<td><img src="', img_url, '" width="250"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Interactive Demo</a><br><a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source Code</a></td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}

cat('</table>')
